description: This file defines a class ADODB2_sapdb for managing data dictionary operations specific to SAP DB within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. The class includes methods for type conversion, SQL generation for altering database schema, and maintains database-specific configurations.

classes.name: ADODB2_sapdb
classes.description: Class for SAP DB-specific data dictionary operations, extending the general ADODB_DataDict class.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts meta information to actual database type names based on SAP DB specifics.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Determines the meta type code for a given data type, considering length and object properties.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffix string for column definitions based on attributes like nullability, default values, and constraints.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to add a column to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to alter a column in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to drop a column from a table.
